_readme: THE ONE FILE TO EDIT. See README.md.
_version_readme: Raise when you publish a new app (new screens, fixes). New LESSONS don't need a new version: installed apps download them from the website.
_site_readme: The website the app activates against and downloads new lessons from.
_publicKey_readme: Filled in by `npm run content:fetch` from <siteUrl>/desktop-app/public-key/. The app trusts only licences signed by the website's matching private key.
_contact_readme: How schools reach you for an unlock code, shown next to the computer's number, e.g. "WhatsApp 0803 000 0000". Empty: not shown.
_sync_readme: How often a running app checks for new lessons when the internet is there, in hours.
_capture_readme: true = screenshots and screen recording show the app as black (Windows; Linux can't).
